messages:
sam: FYI ran a small NDJSON streaming canary with micro-quant (INT8 PTQ) on our funcall suite. seeing an odd class of failures: stream emits valid NDJSON lines but final newline missing, which breaks downstream ndjson parser. baseline float had ~0.2% stream-trail errors, int8 is ~2.9%
toni: do we have an example snippet? the trailing-newline bug could be a streaming flush issue or early eos token.
sam: pasted one of the raw stream captures:
```
{"tool":"search","items":[{"id":"p1","score":0.92}]}
{"tool":"summarize","summary":"Found 1 relevant result"}
{"tool":"card","card":{"title":"Product p1","price":9.99}}
{"tool":"end","status":"ok"}
```
(note: analyzer flagged no trailing \n after last line in several captures)
raj: interesting. that's different from classic suffix truncation where JSON is malformed. Here lines are ok but the stream termination marker missing so ndjson ingestion blocks on read. could be tokenization difference in EOS token generation in quant kernel.
sylvia: we should compare token sequences at stream tail between float and int8 for same prompts. if int8 emits a different special token id or truncates earlier due to kv-cache boundary it would explain this. also check chunking logic in the runtime: are we flushing partial buffer on EOS?
sam: I kicked off a tail-token dump job for 500 samples, dumping last-48 token ids + decoded text to s3://redwood-canary/ndjson-tail/1767701122/.
toni: for immediate mitigation I suggest two layers:
- runtime-level: add a soft-terminator postprocess that ensures final newline is present for NDJSON routes
- client-level: increase read timeout for ndjson consumers by 500ms and accept EOF as valid termination
but we should avoid hiding the regression; add metrics for "ndjson.stream.eos_missing.raw" and "ndjson.stream.eos_repaired.postproc"
sam: agreed. will add those metrics and a dashboard. also propose AB rollout for repair strategy: 40% int8+repair, 30% int8_raw, 30% float. collect raw vs repaired rates separately.
raj: also add a semantic-sanity check: sample 100 repaired streams and rerun the contract verifier to ensure repair did not change meaning (e.g., concatenated lines or dropped items).
sylvia: one more failure mode we saw in PTQ: merged adjacent NDJSON lines into a single line (no separator). that actually causes parse errors, not just missing newline. example:
```
{"tool":"search","items":[{"id":"p1"}]}{"tool":"card","card":{"title":"p1"}}
```
which is two JSON objects glued. that is a decoder boundary issue.
toni: glueing suggests tokenization produced no separator token between objects (space or \n). maybe decoder beam ends with '}' then model chooses next token that decodes to '{' directly. float rarely does that but int8 seems to.
raj: plan:
- dump last-64 logits for glue cases (raj)
- enable NDJSON postprocess with two strategies: repair-by-insert-newline OR repair-by-ndjson-split heuristics that find object boundaries (sylvia)
- collect healed_ok vs semantic_diff metrics (sam)
- rollback rule: if raw_missing_eos_int8 > 1% for 30m OR repaired_semantic_fail > 8% then stop canary (ops)
sam: created ticket ENGML-4830 and put raw captures + sample diffs there. PR with postprocess shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/860
ops-bot: deploy: ndjson-repair AB rollout started -> groups: int8_repair(40%), int8_raw(30%), float_baseline(30%) @ 11:04 UTC
sylvia: note for evals: when running contract verifier on repaired outputs, make sure to test for ordering preservation in arrays and duplicate suppression; simple newline insertion is cheap but not always correct.
raj: also check interaction with retries: if client retries on no-EOS then we might return duplicate lines when the retry merges with original. add idempotency token in stream header so we can dedupe on ingestion.
toni: adding idempotency header is low-risk; will push config change to canary route.
sam: timeline:
- sam: dashboard + metrics (30m)
- raj: logits + glue-case dump (2h)
- sylvia: postprocess implementation + heuristics (1.5h)
- toni: idempotency header + client timeout bump (45m)
we'll reevaluate in 4h and either continue canary or rollback.
ops-bot: alert: ndjson.stream.eos_missing.raw rate crossed 1% threshold in int8_raw at 11:36 UTC (info).
ops-bot: deploy note: AB groups updated to match rollout PR.
